"""Targeted multi-cycle warmup: chain with restricted send phases."""
import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
import ref, para, algo
prof={"groups":1,"jitter_ps":[0],"measurements":[]}
cal=para.build_calib(prof)
N=5; T=10; S=100; Q=1
links=[{"ends":[[i,0,0],[(i+1)%N,1,0]],"delay_ns":[8*T,1],"defer_rounds":[8,0]} for i in range(N)]
fb={"n":N,"interval_ns":T,"slice_ns":S,"offset_ns":0,"drift_ppb":[0]*N,"heat":[],
    "anchors":[[0,0,1]],"links":links,"slices":[list(range(N))],"blackouts":[],
    "guards_ns":[0,5,20],"reconfig_ns":0}
for g in fb['guards_ns']:
    fab,B,A,peak,warm = ref.envelope(fb,cal,g)
    print('g',g,'P',fab.P,'peak',peak,'warm',warm)
    print('  ages',A)
    ok=ref.check(fb,cal,g,extra_cycles=3)
    print('  check',ok)
plan=algo.compile_plan(prof,fb)
print('plan warm',plan['warmup_cycle'],'guard',plan['guard_ns'],'peaks',plan['peaks_as'])
print('audit',algo.audit(prof,fb,plan))
